hindi: वाणी के स्वामी के लिए, बलवान के अंशुओं से, हाथों से पवित्र किए गए होकर तुम शुद्ध बहो। हे देव, देवों के लिए शुद्ध बहो, तुम जिनके भाग हो।
english: Flow clear for the lord of speech, purified by the hands with the shoots of the strong one. O god, flow clear for the gods, whose portion you are.

hindi: हमारे लिए मधुर अन्न-रस बनाओ। हे सोम, तुम्हारा जो अवंचनीय जागृत नाम है, उस के लिए, हे सोम, तुम सोम के लिए स्वाहा। स्वाहा। मैं विस्तृत अंतरिक्ष के पीछे-पीछे चलता हूँ।
english: Make sweet refreshments for us. That name of yours, O Soma, which is not to be deceived and is wakeful: to it, to you, O Soma, to Soma, svāhā. Svāhā. I follow along the wide mid-space.
notes: adābhyam read as a-dābhya 'not to be deceived' (alternatively 'inviolable'). Line 2 begins with svāhā, so the first line closes at 'svāhā' and the second restarts it.

hindi: तुम स्वाङ्कृत हो, समस्त इन्द्रियों के लिए, दिव्य और पार्थिव के लिए; मन तुम्हें प्राप्त करे; स्वाहा। हे सुभव, तुम सूर्य के लिए; तुम देवों के लिए, किरणें पीने वालों के लिए; दिव्य किरणों के लिए; जिसके लिए मैं तुम्हारी स्तुति करता हूँ, वह सत्य है, उपरिप्रुता; भङ्ग से वह मारा गया, फट्। तुम प्राण के लिए, तुम व्यान के लिए।
english: You are the svāṅkṛta, for all the powers, the heavenly and the earthly; may the mind reach you. Svāhā. You, O one of good being, for Sūrya; you for the gods, for the ray-drinkers; for the divine rays; that for which I praise you is true, upariprutā; by breaking he is slain, that one: phaṭ. You for the breath, you for the vyāna.

text_flags.why: the plural dative devāṃśubhyaḥ is expected from the agreement with the neighbouring 'marīcipebhyaḥ'; the printed form devāṃśo is unclear and is kept in src

notes: Several forms are obscure: svāṅkṛta, subhava, devāṃśaḥ, upariprutā, tveḍe, manas tvāṣṭu (read as manaḥ tvā aṣṭu; the alternative is a form of tvaṣṭṛ). 'asau' stands for the named person in an imprecation; the line does not name him. Printed faṭ is read as phaṭ (the Devanagari has a nukta).

hindi: तुम उपयाम से ग्रहण किए गए हो। भीतर थामो, हे मघवन्, सोम का पान करो। धन के लिए रक्षा करो; यह, यज्ञ करो।
english: You are taken up with the upayāma. Hold within, O bounteous one; drink the Soma. Protect for wealth; this one, sacrifice.
notes: 'rāya eṣo' is read as rāye eṣaḥ; the last clause is obscure (eṣaḥ may also be a verb form or 'wish'). Meaning of upayāma is not explained by the line, so it is left untranslated in the gloss.

hindi: तुम्हारे भीतर मैं द्यावापृथिवी को रखता हूँ, भीतर विस्तृत अंतरिक्ष को रखता हूँ। निचले और ऊँचे देवों के साथ मिलकर अन्तर्याम में हर्षित हो, हे मघवन्।
english: Within you I place heaven and earth; within I place the wide mid-space. United with the lower and the higher gods, rejoice in the antaryāma, O bounteous one.
notes: 'te' is read as 'within you' (locative sense of te with antaḥ); antaryāma is left untranslated; 'devebhir avarair' read as 'with the gods, with the lower (ones)'.
lines_deva: अ॒न्तस्ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी द॑धाम्य॒न्तर्द॑धाम्यु॒र्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स॒जूर्दे॒वेभि॒रव॑रै॒ः परै॑श्चान्तर्या॒मे म॑घवन्  मादयस्व

english: Come to us, O Vāyu, drinker of the bright; a thousand are your teams, O one of all choice treasures. O god, I have brought to you the intoxicating juice, of which you hold the first drink. You for Vāyu.
notes: ayāmi is read as a passive aorist 'has been brought' in the sense 'I have brought' (uncertain); andhaḥ read as soma juice; niyut is a team of horses (literal 'harnessed ones').

english: This Soma is pressed for you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa, strengtheners of order. Hear my call here. You are taken up with the upayāma; you for Mitra and Varuṇa.

english: Having won with wealth, may we rejoice, as the gods with the oblation and the cows with fodder. O Mitra and Varuṇa, give us every day that milch cow which does not kick. This is your womb; you for the two ṛtāyu.
notes: 'devā' taken as nominative plural in a comparison with 'gāvaḥ'. 'ṛtāyubhyām' obscure (perhaps 'devoted to ṛta'); left as ṛtāyu in the translation. Printed 'pasfurantīm' is read apasphurantīm (f for ph).

तां धे॒नुं मि॑त्रावरुणा यु॒वं नो॑  वि॒श्वाहा॑ धत्त॒मन॑पस्फ़ुरन्तीमे॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रृता॒युभ्यां॑ त्वा

english: O Aśvins, with that sweet whip of yours which has sūnṛtā, sprinkle the sacrifice. You are taken up with the upayāma; you for the two Aśvins; this is your womb; you for the two sweet ones.
notes: 'mimikṣatam' glossed 'sprinkle, mix'; sūnṛtā left untranslated (kindly truth). 'mādhvībhyām' (dual) read as 'for the two sweet ones' (uncertain).
lines_deva: या वां॒ कशा॒ मधु॑म॒त्यश्वि॑ना सू॒नृता॑वती । तया॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षतम् । उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्माध्वी॑भ्यां त्वा

hindi: उस को, पुराने ढंग से, पहले के ढंग से, सब ढंग से, इस ढंग से; ज्येष्ठता वाले को, बर्हि पर बैठने वाले को, स्वर्ग को पाने वाले को; सामने की ओर मुड़े वृजन को तुम दुहते हो, कँपाने वाले, शीघ्र, जीतते हुए को; जिनमें तुम बढ़ते हो। तुम उपयाम से ग्रहण किए गए हो, शण्ड के लिए; यह तुम्हारी योनि है; वीरता की रक्षा करो; शण्ड पोंछकर हटाया गया; उज्ज्वल को पीने वाले देव तुम्हें आगे ले चलें; तुम अजेय हो।
english: Him, in the old way, in the former way, in every way, in this way; the one of supremacy, seated on the barhis, finding heaven; the vṛjana turned towards, you milk, the shaker, the swift, the conqueror, along those in which you grow. You are taken up with the upayāma, for Śaṇḍa; this is your womb; protect valour; Śaṇḍa is wiped away; may the gods, drinkers of the bright, lead you forth; you are unassailable.
notes: Line 1 is syntactically loose and several forms are obscure (jyeṣṭhatāti, vṛjana, dhuni, the antecedent of 'yāsu'); 'turned towards us' for pratīcīnam is an assumption (literally 'turned towards/westward'). hindi: उत्तम वीरों वाले होकर, वीरों को उत्पन्न करते हुए, धन की वृद्धि के साथ यजमान के चारों ओर जाओ। द्यौ और पृथ्वी से मिलते हुए, उज्ज्वल, उज्ज्वल ज्वाला से; शण्ड बाहर फेंका गया है; तुम उज्ज्वल के अधिष्ठान हो।
english: Being rich in good heroes, begetting heroes, go around the sacrificer with increase of wealth. Meeting heaven and earth, bright, with bright flame, Śaṇḍa is cast out; you are the seat of the bright one.
notes: 'divā' read as instrumental of div (with heaven); it could also mean 'by day'. 'abhi' read with 'parīhi' (go around towards).

hindi: हे देव सोम, तुम्हारे अटूट सुवीर्य और धन की वृद्धि के हम देने वाले हों। वह प्रथम संस्कृति है, सब वरणीय वस्तुओं वाली; वह प्रथम है, वरुण, मित्र, अग्नि।
english: O god Soma, may we be givers of your unbroken good heroic power and increase of wealth. That is the first saṃskṛti, with all choice things; he is the first: Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni.
notes: The printed '~' in 'sa~skṛti' stands for ṃ. 'saṃskṛti' is left near the Sanskrit (preparation, refinement); the sense of 'prathamo varuṇo mitro agniḥ' is a list of names with 'first' as stated, no identification added.

english: He, the first, Bṛhaspati, the knowing one: to that Indra pour the pressed Soma. Svāhā. May the oblations be satisfied with the mead, those that are well sacrificed, well pleased, well offered; which the Āgnīdhra offered with svāhā.
notes: 'hotrāḥ' taken as oblations/offering-functions (uncertain); 'madhvaḥ' as genitive 'of mead'. The agent in the last clause is 'agnīt', the short form of agnīdh.

hindi: इस वेन ने पृश्नि को गर्भ-स्थान मानने वालों को प्रेरित किया; ज्योति का आवरण, रजस् के विस्तार में। इसे जलों और सूर्य के संगम पर, प्रेरित जन मतियों से शिशु की तरह दुलारते हैं। तुम उपयाम से ग्रहण किए गए हो; तुम मर्क के लिए।
english: This Vena impelled those who have Pṛśni as their womb, the light-membrane, in the expanse of the airy space. Him, at the meeting of the waters and of Sūrya, the inspired ones caress with their thoughts, like a child. You are taken up with the upayāma; you for Marka.
notes: Line 0 is very obscure (venaḥ, pṛśnigarbhāḥ, jarāyū); the translation keeps the words close to the Sanskrit. 'apām saṃgame sūryasya' could mean 'at the meeting of the waters and of Sūrya'. Marka is left as a name.

english: In whose calls, sharp like the mind, you two, running, win the vipaḥ with skill. He who, of great manly power, with arrows, mixed the direction in the hand. This is your womb; protect the offspring. Marka is wiped away; may the gods, drinkers of the manthin, lead you forth; you are unassailable.
notes: Lines 0 and 1 are very obscure (vipaḥ, āśrīṇīta ādiśam, the referent of 'yeṣu' and of 'asya'); the translation stays close to the words and builds no firm reading. 'pra' and 'ṇayantu' are split across two tokens in the print (pra-nayantu).

english: You gods who are eleven in heaven, eleven on earth, and eleven dwelling in the waters by your greatness: you gods, enjoy this sacrifice.

english: You are taken up with the upayāma; you are the āgrayaṇa, the good āgrayaṇa. Protect the sacrifice, protect the lord of the sacrifice; may Viṣṇu protect you with power; you protect Viṣṇu; protect the pressings.

hindi: सोम शुद्ध बहता है; सोम इस ब्रह्म के लिए, इस क्षत्र के लिए, इस निचोड़ने वाले यजमान के लिए शुद्ध बहता है, अन्न और बल के लिए। जलों के लिए, ओषधियों के लिए शुद्ध बहता है; द्यावापृथिवी के लिए शुद्ध बहता है; कल्याण के लिए शुद्ध बहता है; तुम सब देवों के लिए। यह तुम्हारी योनि है; तुम सब देवों के लिए।
english: Soma flows clear; Soma flows clear for this priestly power (brahman), for this ruling power (kṣatra), for this sacrificer who presses, for refreshment and strength. He flows clear for the waters, for the plants; he flows clear for heaven and earth; he flows clear for well-being; you for all the gods. This is your womb; you for all the gods.
notes: The printed forms 'pavata' and 'iṣa' stand for pavate and iṣe before a following vowel. The verb of the last clauses ('pavate') is read as a statement about Soma; the tvā-clause 'you for all the gods' is a separate address. 'subhūtāya' read as 'for well-being' (su-bhūta).

hindi: तुम उपयाम से ग्रहण किए गए हो। बृहत् वाले, बल वाले इन्द्र के लिए, उक्थ की रक्षा करने वाले तुम्हें मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ। हे इन्द्र, तुम्हारा जो बृहद् बल है, उसके लिए, तुम विष्णु के लिए; यह तुम्हारी योनि है; तुम उक्थों के लिए; तुम देवों के लिए; यज्ञ की आयु के लिए देवों की रक्षा करने वाले तुम्हें मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ।
english: You are taken up with the upayāma. For Indra, possessor of the Bṛhat, with vigour, I take you, protector of the uktha. That great vigour of yours, O Indra: for that, you for Viṣṇu; this is your womb; you for the ukthas; you for the gods; I take you, protector of the gods, for the life of the sacrifice.
notes: 'bṛhadvate' and 'bṛhadvayaḥ' are obscure: bṛhat may be 'great' or the name of a chant; 'tasmai tvā viṣṇave' is read as 'for that (vigour), you for Viṣṇu'. uktha is left untranslated.

english: Great Indra, who through strength is like Parjanya the rain-bringer, has grown by the hymns of Vatsa. You are taken up with the upayāma; you for Great Indra; this is your womb; you for Great Indra.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हमें धन के लिए सुपथ से ले चलो, हे देव, सब मार्गों को जानने वाले। हमसे कुटिल पाप को दूर करो। तुम्हारे लिए हम सबसे अधिक नमस्कार का वचन अर्पित करें। स्वाहा।
english: O Agni, lead us by a good path to wealth, O god, knowing all the ways. Keep the crooked sin away from us. To you may we offer the most abundant utterance of homage. Svāhā.

english: May this Agni make wide space for us; may this one go ahead, breaking the foes. May this one win strength in the winning of strength; may this one, thrilled, conquer the enemies. Svāhā.

hindi: मैं तुम्हारे रूप के पास रूप से आया हूँ; सर्वज्ञ तुथ तुम्हें बाँटे। ऋत के मार्ग से आगे चलो; हे चमकती दक्षिणा वाली, स्वर्ग को देखो, अंतरिक्ष को देखो, सदस्यों के साथ प्रयत्न करो।
english: With form I have come to your form; may Tutha, the all-knowing, apportion to you. Go forth by the path of order; O you of gleaming gift, look out over heaven, look out over the mid-space, strive with the members of the sadas.

hindi: अग्नि के लिए वरुण तुम्हें मुझे दे; वह, मैं अमरत्व पाऊँ; दाता के लिए आयु बनो, मुझ ग्रहण करने वाले के लिए सुख बनो। रुद्र के लिए वरुण तुम्हें मुझे दे; वह, मैं अमरत्व पाऊँ; दाता के लिए प्राण बनो, मुझ ग्रहण करने वाले के लिए बल बनो। बृहस्पति के लिए वरुण तुम्हें मुझे दे; वह, मैं अमरत्व पाऊँ; दाता के लिए त्वचा बनो, मुझ ग्रहण करने वाले के लिए सुख बनो। यम के लिए वरुण तुम्हें मुझे दे; वह, मैं अमरत्व पाऊँ; दाता के लिए अश्व बनो, मुझ ग्रहण करने वाले के लिए बल बनो।
english: For Agni may Varuṇa give you to me; that one: may I obtain immortality; be life for the giver, be joy for me, the receiver. For Rudra may Varuṇa give you to me; that one: may I obtain immortality; be breath for the giver, be vigour for me, the receiver. For Bṛhaspati may Varuṇa give you to me; that one: may I obtain immortality; be skin for the giver, be joy for me, the receiver. For Yama may Varuṇa give you to me; that one: may I obtain immortality; be a steed for the giver, be vigour for me, the receiver.
notes: A repeated formula for four recipients. The sentence 'so ’mṛtatvam aśīya' mixes 'he' with a first-person verb and is kept literal. 'mayaḥ' (joy, comfort), 'vayaḥ' (vigour; also food, bird, age) and 'hayaḥ' (steed) are uncertain in this use; the line does not say what is given.
